name: InferenceIndexer
description: Independent AI inference price reporting agency. Get live and historical pricing for AI inference models across providers, including the Standard Inference Token (SIT) composite index.

api.auth: Bearer token via POST /v1/auth/anonymous (instant, free, 10k req/day). Or anonymous read-only with rate limit.

endpoints.description: List and search all models with current pricing, SIT scores, 24h/7d changes
Get detailed pricing for a specific model
Get historical price data for a model (trends over time)
Get all provider endpoints for a model with pricing comparison
List all providers with model counts and ZDR/EU status
Get the latest SIT-Composite index value and tier breakdowns
